role: Technical white paper (v1.3) specifying the overnight recovery measurement: source assembly, sleep-anchored window search, score-ranked window selection, anti-ratchet baseline, frozen versioned recovery score, RR-only sleep staging, vitals sub-score, plus prior-art comparison, verification summary, provenance, parameter table, pseudocode and source map.
toplevel: Markdown only. Appendix C source map lists 40 repository paths; every one exists at main 8d32097. Constants in Appendix A were checked against WindowSelection+Scoring.swift, ArtifactDetection.swift, BaselineTracker.swift, Constants+SleepAndDisplay.swift, Constants+RecoveryScore.swift, Constants.swift (ScoringWeights), RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift (scoringParametersV2 bands) and SleepRefreshPolicy.swift and match.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals
units.does: no behavioural claim: title block: version v1.3, author, source revision e028039, scoring version v3.1.oct2026 (matches ScoringVersion.current, ScoringVersion.swift), citation line.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > Executive Summary
units.does: Summarizes the method: strap internal recording preferred with stream gap fill de-duplicated within 50 ms, undated strap file dated from RR sleep onset vs HealthKit sleep start, window search in 30-70% of measured sleep mapped onto the beat timeline, windows ranked by the Tier-1 HRV sub-score less the ANS term, structural anti-ratchet baseline admission with one slot per wake-date night scored only against earlier nights, frozen scores stamped with a scoring version ('unversioned' when absent), RR-only sleep staging with conservative Watch augmentation. Each claim matches the cited code (DataSourceSelector, SleepBoundaryResolver.detectSleepOnset, WindowSelector, BaselineTracker, ScoringVersion, HRVSleepStageClassifier).

flags.text: The paper says the time-domain arithmetic is checked against the 20 nsr2db records 'on every build'. That check is a unit test (HRVReferenceValidationTests), and the unit suite runs only in ci.yml, which is workflow_dispatch/workflow_call only with default scope 'gates' (no tests); the push-triggered gates.yml runs no xcodebuild test. The check runs on manual 'unit'/'full' CI runs, TestFlight releases and local make ci, not on every build.

units.does: Describes the processing phases A-M: capture with 60 s JSONL backup, source selection, segment merge, whole-series artifact flags, sleep boundary cascade (HealthKit -> RR HR -> Watch HR -> recording bounds), band mapping, window scan, selection, analysis, tiered scoring, freeze, baseline update, bounded later rescoring. Each phase maps to the listed code paths.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.1 Capture and source selection > 3.1.1 Parallel capture and backup
units.does: Claims streamed beats are appended to a JSONL file (header then one object per beat, only beats beyond the stored count), flushed at least every 60 s and forced on reconnect/lifecycle, with a file protection class writable while locked, and failed appends keep beats buffered. Code: RawRRBackup.appendBackup/startAppendFormat/writeAppendData write with .completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication (RawRRBackup+Streaming.swift:45,55,92,108); overnight backup tick in RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.runOvernightIncrementalBackup.

units.does: Claims the strap start sequence is fixed as [rescueExisting, clearExisting, beginRecording], rescue downloads a stored recording the ledger does not hold, failure aborts instead of clearing, and a test asserts rescue precedes clear for every strap type. Code: StrapStartSequence.Step cases at StrapStartSequence.swift:39-43, rescuesBeforeClearing at :62; tests EmuquTests/StrapStartSequenceTests.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.1 Capture and source selection > 3.1.3 Source selection
units.does: Specifies source selection: valid = >=120 beats; internal preferred unless internal is shorter by >5%; then gaps where next.t_ms - prev.endMs > prev.rr + 2000; fill with streamed beats whose wallClockMs ?? t_ms lies in a gap; two-pointer merge with cluster-aware 50 ms de-dup both directions, streamed t_ms rebased to wallClockMs; composite failure falls to streaming. Code matches DataSourceSelector.swift:7-17,46-61,124-135,177-183,204-218,242-303.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.1 Capture and source selection > 3.1.4 Dating an undated strap recording
units.does: Specifies dating an undated strap recording: HealthKit sleep for the 24 h ending now with the beats; start = T_hk - onset (onset 0 if none); else now - duration. Onset detector: >300 beats, 120-beat windows in 30-beat steps with >half valid RR, >15 windows, ceiling = midpoint of night's HR range, first j in 5..count-11 with before(5)-after(10) > 8 bpm and after < ceiling, clamped to 20 min. Code: DeviceRecordingSession.healthKitAlignedStart/recordingStart (RRCollector+DeviceRecording.swift:306-329), SleepBoundaryResolver.detectSleepOnset/onsetHRWindows/windowMeanHR/firstSustainedDrop (SleepBoundaryResolver.swift:219-284).

flags.text: OnsetDetection.minimumWindows = 10 (SleepBoundaryResolver.swift:202) is never read; detectSleepOnset hard-codes 'hrWindows.count > 15' (:222), which is the value the paper documents. The named constant disagrees with the shipped rule.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.2 Pause/resume concatenation
units.does: Specifies pause/resume concatenation: offset = child.start - parent.start, refused if <=0 or unrepresentable (child analyzed alone), child t_ms and wallClockMs shifted, parent beats then shifted child beats, chains accumulate, pause becomes a recording break. Code: OvernightStreamingCoordinator.childPointsOffsetToParent guards offsetMs > 0 (RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.swift:227-236), mergeParentSessionData/mergedBaseSession.

flags.text: Backup-recovery reassembly of a parent/child pause chain uses a different offset rule, max(parentDurationMs, dateOffsetMs) (RRCollector+BackupRecovery.swift:614), than the live merge's child.start - parent.start (RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.swift:227); the paper documents only the live rule, so a recovered night can place the child segment at a different offset than the documented method.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.3 Artifact handling > 3.3.1 Whole-series classifier
units.does: Specifies the whole-series classifier: centered median of up to 51 RR (+-25), flags in order technical (<300 or >2000), extra (<0.5m), ectopic (0.5-0.7m), missed (>1.5m), ectopic (1.2-1.5m), ectopic (|r-m|/m > 0.20), else clean. Code: ArtifactDetector Config windowSize 50 -> halfWindow 25 (Constants.swift Artifacts.windowSize, ArtifactDetection.swift:130-160), classify/shortBeatFlags/longBeatFlags (ArtifactDetection.swift:48-108) produce exactly this table.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.3 Artifact handling > 3.3.2 Per-window local ectopic gate
units.does: Specifies the per-window local gate: keep a valid unflagged RR if |r-med|/med <= 0.20 where med is the median of up to 10 neighbours excluding the beat; windows with <=10 values keep all; reported metrics apply the same gate. Code: WindowSelector.ectopicKeepMask/keepsBeat/medianExcluding with localMedianWindow 10 and ectopicThresholdPercent 0.20 (WindowSelection+Filters.swift:48-110, WindowSelection+Scoring.swift:46-48).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.3 Artifact handling > 3.3.3 Masked RMSSD with recording breaks
units.does: Specifies recording breaks (t gap > rr_prev + 2000, or wall gap > rr_i + rr_prev + 2000) and masked RMSSD over kept, originally adjacent pairs not following a break; 0 in selection, missing in reporting, with a reporting-only fallback to artifact-clean pairs. Code: TimeDomainAnalyzer.isRecordingBreak/beatsAfterRecordingBreak (TimeDomainAnalysis.swift:182-197), WindowSelector.maskedRMSSD (WindowSelection+Filters.swift:121-131).

units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for sleep boundaries and search band.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.4 Sleep boundaries and the search band > 3.4.1 Boundary sources
units.does: Claims morning-path boundaries come from HealthKit sleep fetched with the RR series for cross-checking, else an RR HR estimate (5-min windows >=10 beats, midpoint threshold, onset = first of 3 below, clamp 20 min, wake = window after last below), else Watch passive HR (2 points, >=8 bpm range), else recording bounds; negative onset clamped to 0; HR may move onset earlier freely, later only without detailed stages and by >15 min; HR only extends wake. Code: MorningProcessingService.pollForSleepData/applySleepEstimates, HRSleepEstimator.computeWindowedHR/detectSleepBoundariesFromHR/hrSleepThreshold, SleepBoundaryResolver.reconciledStart/reconciledEnd.

flags.text: Step 1 says morning-path HealthKit sleep is fetched with the RR series so the HealthKit layer can cross-check it. pollForSleepData first returns prefetched or SleepDataCache data without any RR cross-check when it plausibly belongs to the recording (MorningProcessingService+Sleep.swift:51-53, 90-107; the comment at :73-89 states the bypass), so on the common cached path the HR reconciliation rules of this section do not run.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.4 Sleep boundaries and the search band > 3.4.2 Wall-clock to beat-timeline mapping
units.does: Specifies wall-clock to beat-timeline mapping: identity when the first beat has no wallClockMs; otherwise t_ms offset of first beat with wallClockMs >= firstWall + offset, else last beat; sleepStart = max(0,map) or 0; sleepEnd = min(map(wake), duration) if later than start else duration. Code: WindowSelector.tMsOffset/resolveSleepBoundaries/sleepEndOffset (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift:883-937).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.4 Sleep boundaries and the search band > 3.4.3 Band
units.does: Specifies the band: early/late at 30%/70% of sleep clamped to recording t_ms, index range first t>=early..last t<=late; <120 beats or empty band yields no window. Code: findSearchBand (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift:940-959), searchBand minRequiredBeats 120 (:101-130).

flags.text: The paper gives 120 beats as the minimum series for a window. The production entry findBestWindowWithCapacity returns nil below config.beatsPerWindow = 400 beats (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift:450), and every production caller uses it (HRVAnalysisPipeline.swift:227, MorningProcessingService+Analysis.swift:105, ReanalysisService.swift:240, SessionRecoveryService.swift:372, RRCollector+DeviceRecording.swift:186), so a 120-399 beat recording gets no window, no peak fallback and no analysis (HRVAnalysisPipeline.swift:229-231) instead of the adaptive small window the paper describes.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for window selection.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.1 Adaptive geometry
units.does: Specifies adaptive geometry: size 400 if B>=400, B/2 if B>=240, else max(60, 0.6B); step max(10, size/10); windows end at bandStart+size stepping to <= bandEnd. Code: computeAdaptiveWindowSize (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift:966-977) and scanWindows (WindowSelection+Evaluation.swift:19-44).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.2 Per-window evaluation
units.does: Specifies per-window evaluation: artifactRate = flagged/size vs pass limit; >=50 valid RR; clean floor min(300, max(50, 0.75 size)); masked RMSSD; population SDNN and CV over clean beats; meanHR = 5-95% trimmed sensor HR if >=10 values, plain mean if fewer, else 60000/meanRR; DFA alpha1 if >=64 clean beats (boxes 4-16 by 2^(1/8)); relativePosition from midpoint. Code: evaluateWindow/extractValidRRValues/cleanBeats/computeWindowMetrics/computeMeanHR/computeRelativePosition/scoredBlock (WindowSelection+Evaluation.swift:56-234), DFAAnalyzer.compute/logSpacedBoxSizes.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.3 Two-pass artifact cap
units.does: Specifies the two-pass cap: 10% first, 15% only when the strict pass yields zero windows. Code: scanBandWithArtifactFallback with maxArtifactRateStrict 0.10 / maxArtifactRate 0.15 (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift:32,41,145-170).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.4 Spike filter and organized filter
units.does: Specifies the spike filter (interior window with both neighbours RMSSD>0 and >=1.5x both is removed; empty result falls back to unfiltered list) and organized test (alpha1 in 0.75-1.0 and CV<0.08; CV<0.08 alone when alpha1 is nil). Code: filterIsolatedSpikes/isIsolatedSpike (WindowSelection+Filters.swift:9-31), selectOrganizedWindow fallback (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift:192), ScoredRecoveryBlock.isOrganizedRecovery (ScoredRecoveryBlock.swift:79-94; LF/HF branch dormant because lfHfRatio is always nil).

flags.text: The spike test compares a window with its neighbours in the list of windows that passed evaluation, not with the overlapping windows on the scan grid: scanWindows appends only windows evaluateWindow accepts, and isIsolatedSpike reads windows[i-1]/windows[i+1] of that list. When intervening windows were rejected (artifact cap, clean-beat floor), the 'neighbours' can be far apart and share no beats, contrary to the paper's rationale that adjacent windows share about 90% of their beats; a real sustained state can then be removed as a spike, or a spike survive because its list neighbour is distant.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.5 Ranking by the scoring function
units.does: Specifies ranking: with a leave-current-out baseline, organized windows ranked by Tier1(rmssd, meanHR, alpha1, base) without ANS term or legacy readiness, ties by RMSSD then later position; without baseline by RMSSD then later position; consolidated = survived spike filter and CV<0.08. Code: buildRecoveryWindow/rankByTier1Score/rankByRMSSD/recoveryWindow (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift:288-378) calling RecoveryScoreCalculator.calculateTier1 with readiness nil and no ansBalance.

flags.text: Ranking is said to use the same Tier-1 function and baseline as the score, but rankByTier1Score calls calculateTier1 without referenceDate, so the staleness deduction is computed against the wall clock (Date()) while the frozen score uses the session end. The deduction is equal across a night's windows, so it changes the ranking only when it pushes scores into the 0/100 clamp (ties then fall to RMSSD); on a historical rescore with a stale baseline the ranking function differs from the scoring function.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.6 Fallbacks and peak capacity
units.does: Specifies fallbacks: no organized window -> peak-RMSSD fallback over the same band with the same two-pass scan and spike filter, flagged not organized; nothing -> whole session analyzed; peak capacity over the whole recording with compact geometry (400; N/3 if N>=360; else max(60,0.4N)), 15% cap, spike filter, max RMSSD, shown but not scored. Code: recoveryOrPeakFallback/peakRMSSDFallback/findPeakMetricWindow/scanPeakBand/findPeakCapacity (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift:466-535,589-654); HRVAnalysisPipeline.analyzeSelectedWindow analyzes the full session when recoveryWindow is nil.

flags.text: 'If even that yields nothing, the whole session is analyzed' holds only when peak capacity exists: when neither a recovery/peak-RMSSD window nor a peak-capacity window is found, findBestWindowWithCapacity returns nil (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift:455-458) and analyzeWithAutoWindow returns nil with windowSelectionFailed (HRVAnalysisPipeline.swift:227-231), so the night gets no analysis rather than a whole-session analysis.

units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for the baseline.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.6 Baseline > 3.6.1 Admission (three gates, in order)
units.does: Specifies admission gates: overnight session; quality not insufficient/preSleep; window >= 300000 ms and (organized or session >= 10800 s); the only direction-dependent exclusion comes from quality rule 3 in classifyHRVQuality. Code: BaselineTracker.admitsToBaseline/isStructurallySoundForBaseline (BaselineTracker.swift:345-413), HRVSession.isReliableForHRVAggregates, SessionAcceptanceService.classifyHRVQuality.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.6 Baseline > 3.6.2 One slot per night
units.does: Specifies one slot per night keyed by wake date of the sleep schedule; replacement order: morning reading (end between window start and wake+4h) wins; consolidation (+15% / >=90%); organized (>=95%, organized incumbent beats unorganized newcomer); quality gates (artifact > max(1.5x, 2.0) or CV > 1.3x loses); else >5% readiness improvement; missing defaults 0/false/100%; 90 points kept sorted. Code: mergeIntoNight/shouldReplace/newWindowIsObjectivelyBetter/consolidationVerdict/organizedRecoveryVerdict/passesQualityGates/hrStabilityAcceptable/isMeaningfullyBetterScore (BaselineTracker.swift:440-613), SleepSchedule.nightKey/isMorningReading/morningCutoff (+4h at SleepSchedule.swift:85), maxHistoricalPoints 90.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.6 Baseline > 3.6.3 Statistics
units.does: Specifies statistics: last 60 stored nights, >=3 points and >=3 positive RMSSD; lnMean; lnSD = max(sampleSD * w, 0.10) with w = sqrt(7/n) below 7; hrMean, hrSD floor 0.5; CV7 over last 7 (>=3 positive) else none; lastDate. Code: stats/baselineStats/widenedLnSD/sevenDayCV (BaselineTracker.swift:211-289) with lnRmssdSDFloor 0.10 and meanHRSDFloor 0.5 (Constants+SleepAndDisplay.swift:220-222).

units.does: Specifies leave-current-out: only nights with nightKey strictly earlier than the scored night are used, feeding both ranking and score. Code: recoveryBaselineStats(excludingNightOf:sleepSchedule:) (BaselineTracker.swift:200-208), used by MorningProcessingService.swift:181, ReanalysisService.swift:224, SessionRecoveryService.swift:55, RRCollector.swift:439.

units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading naming scoring version v3.1.oct2026 (matches ScoringVersion.current).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.7 Recovery score (v3.1.oct2026) > 3.7.1 z-mapping
units.does: Specifies z = (ln RMSSD - lnMean)/lnSD mapped piecewise-linearly through (-3,5)(-1.5,25)(-0.75,64)(-0.5,72)(0.5,72)(1.5,90), clamped at ends, NaN -> 50. Code: zToRecoveryScore/interpolate with defaultScoringParameters = scoringParametersV2 (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift:303-367).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.7 Recovery score (v3.1.oct2026) > 3.7.2 Tier-1 HRV sub-score
units.does: Specifies Tier-1: map(z) + clamp(-5 * zHR, +-10) + alpha1 term (+5 in 0.75-1.0, -5 >1.2, -3 <0.60) + CV7 term (-5 <2%, -3 >12%) + ANS term (-6 <-1.5, -3 <-0.5, +2 >=1.5) - staleness min(20, 5(1+(d-7)/7)) for d>=7, clamped 0-100; without baseline legacy readiness*10, else absolute bands 60/45/30/20 -> 85/70/55/40, else 25, no RMSSD -> 50. Code: calculateTier1/baselineNormalisedScore/rhrAdjustment/dfaAlpha1Adjustment/cvAdjustment/ansBalanceAdjustment/stalenessPenalty/absoluteRMSSDScore (RecoveryScoreCalculator+Tiers.swift:19-101, 205-262) with constants in Constants+RecoveryScore.swift:16-91.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.7 Recovery score (v3.1.oct2026) > 3.7.3 Tiers
units.does: Specifies tiers: Tier 3 (sleep+vitals) 0.60/0.25/0.15, comeback 0.80/0.20/0.00 for 21 days from the set date; Tier 2 0.70/0.30 dampened to 0.85/0.15 when z<-1 and Sleep<50; Tier 1 = T1 (vitals unused). Code: ScoreDetailBuilder.buildTierComposite/buildTier3/tier3Weights/buildTier2/buildTier1, ScoringWeights (Constants.swift:400-424), UserSettings.isComebackModeActive (UserSettings+Model.swift:350-356).

flags.text: Comeback mode is evaluated against today's date (UserSettings+Model.swift:350-356 uses Date()), not the scored night, so a historical rescore during an active comeback window reweights an old night 80/20/0 and one after expiry reweights a comeback night 60/25/15; the paper's '21 days from the date it is set' does not say which date governs a rescore.

units.does: Specifies the tail: Tier-1 missing-sleep penalty 10 when sleep integration and the opt-in are on and sleep is nil; clamp 0-100; SpO2 <95% subtracts 10 floored at 0; every deduction listed. Code: missingSleepPenaltyApplies/composeFinalScore (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift:628-698), VitalsScoring.applyVitalsOverrides/vitalsPenaltyDescriptions.

Code: calculateWithBreakdown discards trainingMetrics/trainingContext (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift:463,486); SessionAcceptanceService.applyFrozenScore sets frozenReadiness via ReanalysisService.computeFrozenReadiness.

Code: snapshotHealthData/fetchSleepAndVitals/sleepFetchRange (SessionAcceptanceService.swift:148-185,302-317,515-532), RecoveryVitals.withStrapNocturnalRHR.

units.does: Specifies the quality decision: (1) short window or (unorganized and <3 h) with RMSSD < exp(lnMean) -> insufficient; (2) sleep exists and recording does not overlap it -> preSleep; (3) RMSSD < base and <3 h -> insufficient; else good. Code: classifyHRVQuality/insufficientDataDecision/overlapsSleep (SessionAcceptanceService.swift:62-121).

units.does: Specifies the unusable-reading blend: score with RMSSD = exp(lnMean), meanHR = hrMean, no alpha1, no readiness; with a perceived-readiness answer HRV factor = 0.70 T1 + 0.30*100p (p clamped), recomposed through the missing-sleep and SpO2 tail. Code: FiniteHRVInputs.substitutingBaseline, blendingPerceivedReadiness/blendedFactors/subjectiveScore/composeFinalScore (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift:476-600).

Code: applyFrozenScore/toTenScale, ScoreBreakdown init(from:) defaulting to ScoringVersion.unversioned (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift:138-150), ScoringVersion.current.

units.does: Specifies mutation rules: bulk reanalysis skips manual windows; auto sleep refresh never overwrites a user-edited snapshot but may fill a missing one without rescoring; pulled sessions fill-only; imported duplicates adopt a score only when none exists; auto upgrade only for the most recent scored overnight ending within 18 h, serialized, plausibility-checked, update on first snapshot / end later >60 s / more minutes / onset move >=15 / source upgrade, rescore on first / >=20 min / onset >=15 / upgrade, scoring boundaries moved with the snapshot; cross-device the newer whole-second modifiedAt copy wins. Code: ReanalysisService bulk skip (ReanalysisService.swift:260-263), SleepRefreshPolicy.*, SessionReanalysisCoordinator.loadTodaysOvernightSession/performAutoRefreshTodaysSleepIfImproved/freshPlausibleSleep, SessionMerger adoptRecoveryScore (SessionMerger.swift:126), CloudKitSessionFreshness.decide/wholeSeconds.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 6. Verification
units.does: Claims every build compares RMSSD/SDNN/pNN50 on 6,000 intervals from 20 nsr2db records against a reference implementation; the Python port matched all 114 ported cases from eight suites but is partial (128 test functions at e028039, 14 not ported incl. live-DFA window-fill gating, arrival-clock dropout break, 8 sleep-stage percentile and 3 HRV-reference tests; some cases are comment-quoted values), so those behaviours are not confirmed; reports MIT-BIH artifact results, and lists science-register labels for v3.1.oct2026 (Table 6.1).

flags.text: The paper says the time-domain arithmetic is checked against the 20 nsr2db records 'on every build'. That check is a unit test (HRVReferenceValidationTests), and the unit suite runs only in ci.yml, which is workflow_dispatch/workflow_call only with default scope 'gates' (no tests); the push-triggered gates.yml runs no xcodebuild test. The check runs on manual 'unit'/'full' CI runs, TestFlight releases and local make ci, not on every build.

Paper says RMSSD, SDNN and pNN50 are compared on 6,000 intervals from 20 nsr2db records. pNN50 is only compared on records where the ectopic filter removes no beat (testPNN50MatchesTheReferenceWhereNoBeatIsFiltered; 16 of 20 in the port run), and the RMSSD comparison is of the unfiltered value; the pipeline RMSSD is only checked to be <= unfiltered.
